messages:
Maria (Finance): Hey team — spotted a weird invoice line in the most recent billing export: `GPU-Hourly-Commit` shows both committed and burst minutes being billed in the same hour. Anyone seeing this?

Sam (FinOps): Hmm, can you paste the invoice lines?

Maria (Finance): 
```
LineItemId: li-0abc123
Description: GPU-Hourly-Commit | Region: us-west1 | UsageStart: 2026-02-12T03:00:00Z | UsageEnd: 2026-02-12T04:00:00Z | Qty: 60m | Amount: $120.00
LineItemId: li-0abc124
Description: GPU-Burst-Minutes | Region: us-west1 | UsageStart: 2026-02-12T03:02:00Z | UsageEnd: 2026-02-12T03:04:00Z | Qty: 2m | Amount: $4.00
```

Kevin (Infra): We had an autoscaler canary that spun up 1 extra GPU for ~90s at 03:02Z, then shut down. Shouldn't be billed twice for the same time window.

Priya (SRE): That canary is our test rollout. It definitely created a burst node for health-checks. It was ~1.5m. We expected per-second billing to pro-rate into the committed pool if overlap exists.

Sam (FinOps): Looks like provider's export applies rounding to the nearest minute for burst lines but reserved is represented as '60m' regardless, so the overlap might be double-counted if they don't de-dup.

Maria (Finance): I've opened a support case with cloud billing — case #CB-789201. Asked for line-item logic and overlap de-duping rules. Requested an interim credit.

billing-bot: Case CB-789201 status changed to 'In Review' by cloud-support.

Kevin (Infra): Short-term mitigation: can we throttle canary concurrency to avoid spinning GPUs for <2min? Also consider increasing the reserved pool coverage window for canaries.

Priya (SRE): I'll patch the canary to 30s warm + 30s steady to avoid multiple short-lived nodes. Also adding a preflight check to skip canary if pool already has free capacity.

Sam (FinOps): If cloud confirms double-billing, we should request retroactive credit and also create an alert in cost-monitoring when burst minutes from canaries > 1m in hour.

Maria (Finance): Thanks. I'll update thread when I hear back. For now, marking the canary change as critical ops action. :point_up: :thumbsup:

Kevin (Infra): noted.

Priya (SRE): done — PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/merge/222

Maria (Finance): closing loop for now — will post provider response.
